title: Empowering Edge Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Edge-Cloud Collaboration in LLM Agent Execution
authors_zh: Pengcheng Huang、Zhenghao Liu、Shixin Ren、Shi Yu、Sijia Yao、Yukun Yan、Chaojun Xiao、Maosong Sun
paper_type_zh: 端云智能体评测基准与隐私反馈研究
best_for_zh: 研究智能体任务验证、端云协作成本与隐私评测的读者。
one_line: EC2-Bench releases 128 executable workspace evaluation tasks, 100 with privacy annotations, jointly scoring agent task performance, cloud resource use, and annotated information exposed to cloud collaborators.
EC²-Bench 发布 128 个工作空间评测任务，其中 100 个有隐私标注，联合测量任务表现、云端资源和向云模型暴露的敏感信息。
why: It separates successful agent execution from resource use and cloud-visible sensitive information; its evaluation feedback should not be mistaken for a released agent-training dataset.
inclusion_reason: An agent evaluation surface whose mixed task checks and sensitivity annotations define explicit task-performance and cloud-boundary privacy feedback contracts.

title: Problem
问题
html: An edge agent may improve by consulting a stronger cloud model, but task success alone hides monetary cost and disclosure of local workspace information. EC2-Bench studies this evaluation problem through long-horizon, executable workspace tasks. The relevant atlas object is the benchmark task, its checks, and its sensitivity annotations. It is classified as an evaluation surface, without inferring that its tasks or logs were used for agent training.
端侧智能体咨询更强的云模型可能提高任务表现，但只看任务成功会掩盖费用以及工作空间信息的披露。EC²-Bench 通过可执行的长程工作空间任务研究这一评测问题。本卡关注任务、检查器与敏感性标注，将其归为评测表面，不推断这些任务或日志曾用于训练智能体。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The benchmark jointly measures task performance, resource use, and privacy exposure. It contains 128 executable tasks; 100 include sensitivity annotations. Query routing, per-step routing, edge-controlled delegation, and edge-controlled advisory are compared alongside edge-only and cloud-only execution. The three axes remain separate so that a task-completion gain or a cost reduction cannot stand in for a privacy claim.
基准联合测量任务表现、资源使用与隐私暴露，共有 128 个可执行任务，其中 100 个包含敏感性标注。论文对比查询路由、逐步路由、端侧控制委派、端侧控制建议，以及纯端侧和纯云端执行。三个维度分别报告，避免把完成率提升或云端费用下降替代为隐私结论。

title: Method
方法
html: Tasks run in a shared OpenClaw-based agent framework. Completion combines task-specific rule checks, environment-state audits, and semantic rubric judgments. Cloud raw/cache-read/output tokens determine the reported cloud cost, while a model judge checks whether annotated sensitivity units became visible in cloud-call contexts. Paper Appendix A.9 used E2B sandboxes; the inspected public release provides per-task Docker environments. These are distinguished rather than treating the public runtime as the historical scoring environment.
任务在共同的 OpenClaw 框架下执行。完成分数结合规则检查、环境状态审计和语义评分；云端原始输入、缓存读取与输出词元用于计算费用；模型评审判断敏感单元是否出现在云端可见上下文中。论文附录的原实验使用 E2B 沙箱，已检查的公开版本则提供逐任务 Docker 环境，不能把二者直接视作同一个历史测分环境。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper repeats every task-configuration pair three times and reports means plus Pass3, using completion >0.7 as the per-run success threshold. For privacy judgment, it reports 96.9% F1 against adjudicated human labels on 200 sensitivity-unit/context pairs. That is evidence for agreement on the audited sample, not proof of perfect leakage detection or formal privacy protection. Privacy results apply to the 100 annotated tasks, not all 128 without qualification.
每个任务与配置独立运行三次，报告均值及三次都成功的比例；单次成功阈值为完成分数大于 0.7。隐私评审在 200 对敏感单元与上下文上，与经裁定的人类标签相比达到 96.9% 的 F1。这是所检查样本上的一致性证据，不是完美检测或形式化隐私保护的证明。隐私得分只覆盖有标注的 100 个任务。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The contribution is a shared agent-execution evaluation surface that makes cloud-boundary disclosure measurable beside task outcomes and cloud resources. Sensitive content may be paraphrased, so the exposure contract uses semantic model judgment rather than only literal matching. The paper analyzes collaboration strategies; it does not establish a new agent-training corpus or a deterministic privacy guarantee.
其贡献是把云端边界的信息披露、任务结果与云端资源消耗放到同一套智能体执行评测中。由于敏感内容可能被改写，暴露判定依赖语义模型评审，而不是仅做字面匹配。论文研究协作策略，没有因此产生一套已用于训练的智能体语料，也没有给出确定性的隐私保证。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Coverage is limited to the annotated sensitivity units and contexts made visible to the cloud. Judge errors, other data channels, external service state, model changes, caching and price assumptions can change conclusions. The benchmark does not certify privacy or production reliability. Exact historical paper-run manifests and third-party task/asset rights require further audit. The higher-capability models are proxies for future edges; these experiments are not a hardware-deployment proof.
覆盖范围受敏感性单元和云端可见上下文的定义限制。评审误差、其他数据通道、外部服务状态、模型版本、缓存与定价都会影响结果。基准不能认证生产可靠性或隐私安全；精确的历史运行清单和改编任务、素材的权利仍需继续核验。较强模型是未来端侧能力的代理，不等于已经完成真实端设备部署验证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use the tasks and grading definitions to compare matched edge-cloud agent configurations, reporting completion, cost, and privacy separately. Preserve the annotated subset, task version, scaffold, judge, repeated-run protocol, and cloud pricing assumptions. This card lists evaluation as the sole training_use facet. Reusing the tasks for SFT or RL would be a separate experimental decision requiring split, leakage, licensing, and feedback-validity analysis.
适合在匹配的任务、运行框架和模型配置下比较端云协作，分别报告完成率、费用与隐私。复用时保留标注子集、任务版本、评审、重复次数和价格假设。本卡只登记评测用途；若另行把任务用于监督微调或强化学习，必须重新论证划分、泄漏、许可与反馈契约，不能从基准发布本身推断其训练用途。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 4-5 for the scoring contract and Appendix A.9 for the original environment. Distinguish GLM-5.3 cloud assistance from GPT-5.4-mini task/privacy judgment, and representative small edges from stronger proxy models. Keep all-task completion separate from privacy-subset scoring, and means separate from Pass3. Public Docker execution instructions do not by themselves reproduce paper-era E2B experiments.
优先阅读第四、第五节的得分定义与附录的原始运行环境。区分 GLM-5.3 的云端协助角色和 GPT-5.4-mini 的任务、隐私评审角色，区分代表性小模型与更强代理模型。还要区分全量任务完成分数和隐私标注子集，以及均值和三次均成功指标。公开 Docker 命令不能单独证明复现了原论文的 E2B 实验。

引用
